Her skin tone runs naturally across every area outside the tubes. Background: a real famous place photographed at true scale, a real giant Ferris wheel with rows of colorful gondolas at a lively amusement park, with striped tents and balloon stalls around it placed in the foreground close to the camera at the bottom centre of the frame, rising only to the height of her waist and thighs, tiny visitors, tiny families with strollers and tiny food carts around its base at their real size appearing as small as ants; she is a colossal giant standing just behind and slightly to one side of the foreground landmark, so that it overlaps only part of her legs and clearly shows how much taller than it she is, her towering heels planted on the paved park plaza, a warm afternoon sky with soft white clouds behind her, the whole place clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm golden afternoon light with long gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at knee height, the famous foreground landmark large at the bottom centre of the frame and she standing just behind it, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the real people, vehicles and trees around her ankles shown at their true size so her colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
